name: Carol Burke
bio: Carol runs the business and economy desk from Jacksonville. Her reporting career includes more than a decade covering business, finance, and labor at regional daily newspapers and a national business publication. She is the editor most likely to reach for the underlying numbers on a story and the one who insists on distinguishing what a company has actually announced from what its press release wants readers to think it announced.

seo.metaDescription: Read reporting and analysis from New Media Xpress business editor Carol Burke.
